value: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in building boats. Boats are defined as watercraft not built in shipyards and typically of the type suitable or intended for personal use. Included in this industry are establishments that manufacture heavy-duty inflatable rubber or inflatable plastic boats (RIBs).
Boats (e.g., motorboats, rowboats, canoes, kayaks) manufacturing
Boats (i.e., suitable or intended for personal use) manufacturing
Sailboat building, not done in shipyards
Underwater remotely operated vehicles (ROVs) manufacturing in boat yards
Unmanned and robotic watercraft manufacturing in boat yards
Yacht building, not done in shipyards
